duration.text: The Electrical Engineering at Central South University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) Passport Homepage (Over one-year availability). If the validity of the applicant's current passport does not meet the requirement, please apply for a new passport before submitting the application.2) Highest graduation certificate. If the applicant is currently a student, the pre-graduation certificate issued by the school is required. Non-Chinese/English documents must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations.3) Stamped Transcript of the highest diploma. Non-Chinese/English documents must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations.4) HSK Transcript for Chinese-taught programs and IELTS\TOEFL for English-taught programs, or other documents to prove your linguistic competence.5) Non-criminal record in Chinese/English with an official stamp. The issue date shall be after October 1, 2024.6) Physical Examination Record. Applicants should strictly check the items in accordance with the requirement of Physical Examination Record.pdf Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending doctor, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. The date shall be after October 1, 2024. The original piece is required during registration.7) Self-introduction video. Applicants are required to upload a self-introduction video within one minute, and the holder of HSK certificate must use Chinese to record the video. The video must be in MP4 format with a capacity of less than 40MB. Applicants involved can, with the help of video format conversion software, adjust the resolution ratio, bit rate, and other indexes to adjust the file size.8) Statement of not receiving any scholarships or forms of funding. e.g. Personal Statement.docx9) Two different recommendation letters from professors/associate professors with detailed contacts. The signature date shall be after October 1, 2024.10) Study Plan of no less than 1000 words. Please clarify your research background, method, content, and significance, etc. in the future study.The proposal of a doctoral student shall be signed by the applicant's supervisor in CSU.e.g. Study Plan for International Graduates.docx11) Acceptance letter. e.g. Acceptance Letter.docx (contact info: CSU Profs contact.pdf)12) Published essays, CV or any other supporting materials. (for graduate applicants only)

requirements.text: 1) Excellent Non-Chinese citizens, with no criminal records and in good health.2) For Master's degrees, applicants should have a bachelor's degree and should be 18 to 35 years old; for Doctoral degree, applicants should have a master's degree and should be 18 to 40 years old.3) Language Eligibility: Students who apply for Chinese-taught programs should obtain a minimum score of 260 in HSK4 for science and engineering programs and 200 in HSK5 for arts, social science, and medical programs.Students who apply for English-taught programs should obtain a minimum score of 6 in IELTS or 85 in TOFEL.Those who meet one of the following conditions are exempt from proving their linguistic competence:a) Applicants whose first language or the official language of the country is Chinese or English.b) Applicants who have taken a degree program whose teaching language is in Chinese or English.4) Applicants are required to have a strong academic background and innovative research capabilities.5) Some programs have their own admission requirement, and applicants shall be qualified before applying. For details, see the Program Catalogue.
